features.description: A random symbol expands across its reels during free spins.

features.name: Bonus buy
features.description: Buy free spins with a set number of expanding symbols where permitted.

review:
A goofy archaeologist digs for gold in Egypt on a 5x3, 10-line book-style slot. Three golden shovels trigger the bonus.

At the start of free spins, one symbol is chosen to expand – when enough of it lands, it covers its reels and pays on any line. A bonus buy can start you with a set number of expanding symbols. Very high volatility, a 7,500x max and free spins about once every 173 spins. The RTP is lower than usual for BGaming at 94.94%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
